findings.message: Track 6 has 9 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div id="escena"> is a timeline element that contains nested <canvas id="agua">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="escena"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: index.html, plantilla.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.
